learning_outcomes.text: Regarding the learning outcomes of the program of Bachelor in Engineering, this course contributes to the development and the acquisition of the following learning outcomes: LO 1.1, 1.2, LO 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 2.9, LO 3.1, 3.2, LO 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5, LO 5.1, 5.3, 5.4.

Given the learning outcomes of the "Bachelor in Engineering" program, this course contributes to the development, acquisition and evaluation of the following learning outcomes: S1.I5, S2.1-5, S3.1-3, S4.1-6, S5.1, S5.3, S5.4.

syllabus_topics: Software definition and design linked to mobile computing (Android-compatible application)
Application development using generative AIs and other AI-based development tools
teaching_methods: Encouraged communication in English on a technical theme (oral and/or written)

assessment_methods.method: Project grade (achievements, written document, oral presentations and interactions, work organization, reflection on organization, mastery of topics and concepts)

assessment_rules: The final grade depends on the project grade and an individual written test. The project grade can be individualized based on student implication and cannot be re-taken in the second session. The weight of the written test is 30% if the grade is 10 or more, 100% if 6 or less, and varies linearly for grades between 6 and 10. The second session consists of an individual exam and individual work (2-week sprint) to be done beforehand.
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
